_about: Public-domain James Craigie Robertson (1813-1882), Canon of Canterbury and professor of ecclesiastical history at King's College, London, for the Word Hoard: his History of the Christian Church from the Apostolic Age to the Reformation in the new and revised eight-volume edition (John Murray, 1875-76, with 1904 printings of vols V-VI), Becket, Archbishop of Canterbury (1859), and Sketches of Church History (SPCK, 1887) from Project Gutenberg, from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Not F. W. Robertson, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
